name: Cable Y-Raise
instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley and hold the handles or one handle in each hand at your hips.
Raise your arms forward and up into a Y shape, thumbs pointing up, until they are above head height.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower under control.
Use a light weight and avoid arching your back.
image_prompt_scene: Standing facing a low cable with the hands at the hips.
